methods.description: For10or100times, orone-tenth/one-hundredth of a decimal, move every digit oneor two place-value columns in the correct direction, preserving digit order and zero placeholders.
Compare a digit’s original and resulting columns to choose10,100,one-tenth orone-hundredth.
Undo a known10or100 multiplication/division using the opposite column move and check the original decimal.
Find both scaled values with the taught column moves, then compare their place values, using trailing zeros if helpful.
